templates.name: AI Consulting
templates.subject: Moving AI strategy from experimental to ROI-driven
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most teams are experimenting with AI, but very few have operationalized it to drive measurable ROI. At Brand Vibe Consulting, we help businesses move past the hype to build systems that scale output without inflating headcount.

Depending on your bottlenecks, a targeted AI integration typically delivers:

1. Workflow Compression: Cutting marketing and operational execution times by up to 40%.

2. Cost-Efficient Scaling: Automating personalized content and outreach without proportional agency costs.

3. Precision Analytics: Upgrading data capabilities to track customer journeys and acquisition costs accurately.

Drawing on my background as a fractional CMO and AI faculty at IIT Bombay and IIM Mumbai, I focus strictly on tailored systems that directly impact your bottom line—not generic software.

Are you open to a 15-minute call next week to see if these frameworks align with your growth goals?

Best regards,

Best,
Bithindra Biswas
Founder, Brandvibe.co.in

templates.name: AI Workshop
templates.subject: A hands-on AI workshop for your leadership team
templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most AI workshops end with a slide deck and good intentions. Mine end with your team shipping live automations before lunch.

I run a hands-on AI workshop designed to make teams AI-native—not "AI-aware." Your people work on their own real use cases (sales, marketing, ops, support) inside the session, and walk out having built and deployed working automations, not another framework to file away.

Recent proof: took a B2B leadership team from zero to two live AI automations in one week, covering lead qualification and internal reporting.

Why me: 20+ years running P&Ls across media, telecom, banking, and tech (Sr VP, Radio Mirchi; roles at Idea Cellular, ICICI Bank, IBM). MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. Currently Guest Faculty at IIT Bombay and IIM Mumbai/NMIMS, teaching AI & strategy.

I don't teach AI as theory—I embed it as a working system your team owns by the end of the session.

Worth a 20-minute call to scope a workshop format that fits your team's real workflows?

Best,
Bithindra Biswas
IIM Ahmedabad Alumnus | LinkedIn Top Voice
https://brandvibe.co.in/services/ai-workshops

templates.name: XamBaaz — Principal Intro
templates.subject: A complimentary XamBaaz pilot for your students
templates.body:
Dear Principal,

We would like to invite your school to participate in the XamBaaz National Quiz Challenge—an online, timed quiz designed for Classes 9 and 11 to help students assess their preparedness for competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET and other entrance exams.

The quiz will provide students with an engaging competitive experience while giving them a clear view of their current level of preparedness.

What students receive:

🏆 Amazon Vouchers + 1-year XamBaaz Premium membership for top scorers
📊 complimentary individual preparedness scores and detailed performance analytics for every participant
🎯 Insights into strengths, weaknesses and areas requiring improvement

The competition can be conducted online, making participation simple and requiring minimal effort from the school.

We would be delighted to partner with your school and give your students an opportunity to benchmark themselves against their peers while starting their competitive-exam preparation early.

Please let us know a convenient time to discuss the initiative.

Regards,
Team XamBaaz
www.xambaaz.com
